items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Mateus Leme (MG) is procuring healthcare goods or services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 1,100,841.64; proposals close Dec 1, 09:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
